coordinate_convention: continuous ERP x/W,y/H; 1024x512 normalized coordinates; camera height h=1; floor y=-1

units.Sb: degrees; half the sum of two directed mean nearest-arc spherical distances; NOT per-boundary RMS
units.D: degrees; minimum common-orthogonal-axis length-weighted RMS residual, modulo 90 degrees; NOT mean adjacent corner error
units.Hm: absolute difference of own perimeter-mean whole-wall heights / reference perimeter-mean whole-wall height
units.Hc: symmetric local height residual after removing each geometry's own global mean difference, normalized by reference perimeter-mean whole-wall height; frozen nearest-floor correspondence and tie rule
units.pair_delta_rms_deg: RMS wrapped upper/lower longitude difference; historical local X_rms_deg
units.endpoint_adjustment_rms_deg: half of pair_delta_rms_deg; historical Pro Eperp_deg; minimum per-endpoint longitude correction, not spherical minimum distance
units.floor_boundary_mean_h: symmetric mean nearest Euclidean floor-boundary distance in camera-height units; routing fallback diagnostic, not Sb

sampling.historical_922_frozen_metric_reconstruct: Verified with 2048 spherical / 4096 height. Some prior independent experiments explicitly used 1024; saved results retain that identity.
sampling.convergence_checks: Separate 1024/2048/4096 spherical and 4096/16384 height runs; final-candidate response is checked from the resulting metric pairs.

version_fields.dataset_sha256: sha256 of the complete named source dataset bytes
version_fields.current_points_sha256: historical hash of ordered mean-x ERP points; preserve original field verbatim
version_fields.reference_points_sha256: historical hash of that exact reference point version
version_fields.raw_before_preprocessing_points_sha256_c: hash of raw source endpoints before x averaging; canonical JSON protocol recorded by producer
version_fields.annotation_geometry_sha256: hash of 3D geometry arrays, not interchangeable with ERP point hash
version_fields.reference_candidate_id: externally admitted candidate identity; floor-equivalent aliases may be recorded
version_fields.reference_version: actual confirmation/revision version; unknown remains unknown
version_fields.legacy_input_version: preserved Pro dataset-hash or local calibration_20261012:point-hash string; never joined by fuzzy equality
version_fields.formula_config_sha256: hash of exact delivered candidate configuration

missing_and_qualification.missing_confirmed_reference_top: floor-only score available when valid; complete Q, height losses and 3D IoU are null
missing_and_qualification.invalid_or_missing_geometry: null with explicit reason, never a zero-score substitute
